author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
There’s a new AI chat assistant inside Premiere, Photoshop, and Illustrator – but only in the beta version. This week, we give our first impressions on how Adobe’s AI assistant can streamline workflows in creative production applications.

Apple has increased prices on computers and iPads. Is this just the most recent example in a consistent trend of rising technology prices? Is the build-out of AI tech centers responsible for driving prices up?

We also explore MCP connectors, a powerful standard for connecting multiple applications together with AI assistants. We’ve been using MCP connectors a lot lately and we think they are becoming essential for effective AI workflows.

And, finally, Anthropic’s Fable 5 model is available to the public, after an initial suspension prompted by limitations enforced by the US federal government. What can we expect of the safeguards that Anthropic has put in place?

Hosts: Kevin Stratvert,  Nick Brazzi
#Adobe, #Creativecloud, #Premiere, #Anthropic, #
title: Ep. 03 – AI Assistant in Adobe Creative Cloud
